title: feat(objectql,cli): recompute stored home-currency amounts at the rates in force now, report first, rows without a rate listed and skipped (multi-currency M2-3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJ4XLvydGoPeNPtcqsTzsGU)_

epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZWjnSeed8H4dMjt9d

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新增 `os migrate recompute-home-amounts --object X [--field] [--since DATE] [--apply]`：按「现在生效的汇率」重算已存的本位币金额。默认只出报告（每个组织各自的本位币与条数、哪些行会变、从多少变成多少、哪些行转不了及原因），`--apply` 才写，只写本位币字段与汇率字段，`updated_at` 不动，每次 apply 记一条审计。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0144 D5：改正过的汇率只能经「显式重算」才进到已存的行；给已有数据的对象新加本位币字段时，老行也靠它补齐。
- **风险与回滚：** 不复制任何换算：预览直接调写入时的同一投影函数，apply 走 `engine.update`、由写入自己再算一次，所以重算后的行与新写入一模一样（消融为证）。缺汇率、空币种码、无单据日期、未设本位币的行只列出、不写，命令保持退出码 1 直到补齐。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/home-amount-recompute.ts`（`recomputeHomeAmounts`），再看 `engine.ts` 新增的 `homeAmountReadsFor`（委托到 `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-home-amount-projection.test.ts -t recompute`：改汇率后报告列出 71994.24 → 80000，apply 后与新写入的行相同，再跑一次无变化。
- **需要您做的：** 无。Open item 8（跳过行怎么保持可见）在下方提案并有测试钉住，由 epic PM 带进 ADR 修订。

Fixes #27193

R2.1 of epic #8345 (ADR-0144 D9 R2, M2-3). The R2 core (#28096, #27185, #27198, #28302) shipped in 18.3.0 (ruling 6539345871, letter A′); this rides a later Version Packages, as the epic PM pairs it.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**`@objectstack/objectql` — `recomputeHomeAmounts(engine, logger, { object, field?, since?, apply?, maxRecords?, maxListed?, source? })`** (`home-amount-recompute.ts`), exported with `formatHomeAmountRecomputeReport`, `homeAmountRecomputeComplete` and `HOME_AMOUNT_SKIP_REASONS`. Modelled on `record-currency-backfill.ts` / `summary-backfill.ts`: a keyset walk over `id` under the unscoped system context, one `engine.update` per row that differs.

- **No second copy of the arithmetic.** The preview projects each stored row with `projectHomeAmounts` (the write's own function) over the engine's own reads, `ObjectQL.homeAmountReadsFor(context)`: the same rate-row rule (latest `effective_date` on or before the document date, in the row's organization), exact division, single half-away rounding to the home currency's CLDR fraction digits, rate 1 for the home currency, and a `datetime` document date read as its day in the organization's `localization.timezone`. The apply writes `{ id, <homeField> }` through `engine.update`; a payload touching the home field makes the write project the row again over the stored row, so the value stored is the write's, never the preview's (ablation A2 below).
- **Per organization.** The organization is the one a write converts the row under (the row's `organization_id`); each converts into its own home currency at its own rates, and the report carries one entry per organization (`homeCurrency`, `amounts`, `unchanged`, `changed`, `written`, skipped per reason, `outsideSince`). No deployment-wide answer.
- **Writes only the two projected fields**, under `{ isSystem, preserveAudit }` with the row's stored `updated_at` (the `comment-parent-pair` / `audit-key-material` precedent), so `updated_at` does not move (ablation A3, on SQL).
- **Listed and skipped, never written (parameter 1)**, five reasons: `rate_missing` (with currency and date), `code_blank` (ruling 6492000994 item 5: an amount beside a blank code is its own class; remedy `os migrate record-currency-codes`, not a rate), `document_date_blank`, `home_currency_unset`, `unconvertible` (a code, amount or date the write's validator refuses).
- **`since`** filters on the **document date** (`homeAmount.rateDate`, the date that picks the rate), read as the day the write reads it (a `datetime` in the organization's timezone); a row with no document date is outside every window. Pinned at the timezone boundary (ablation A6).
- **Audit:** one `sys_audit_log` entry per applied run: `action: 'update'`, `object_name`, no `record_id`, `tenant_id` empty (the run spans organizations: a deployment-level row), `metadata` = `{ event: 'home_amount.recompute', source, object, fields, since, counts, organizations, skippedByReason, skipped (≤ 1000), failures, truncated }`. The registry is asked first (the `admin-import-users` posture): with no ledger in the composition the report says `audit: { written: false, reason: 'ledger_not_mounted' }`; a refused insert is warned and reported, and the run that already landed stands.
- Refused before any row is read: unknown object (`OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` / 404), an object or `field` that declares no home amount (`INVALID_FIELD` / 400), a `since` that is not a real `YYYY-MM-DD` (`VALIDATION_FAILED` / 400). The function takes no CLI dependency, so a non-CLI door can call it (no HTTP or Setup door is built here; PR #28128 S1 is open).

**`@objectstack/objectql` — `ObjectQL.homeAmountReadsFor(context?)`** returns `{ serving, organizationOf(row) }`, the reads the write-time projection makes. The facade stays delegation-only: the body is `ReferencesAndMasterDetailFacet.homeAmountReadsFor`.

**`@objectstack/cli` — `os migrate recompute-home-amounts --object <o> [--field <amount>] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--apply] [--yes] [--json] [--force] [--max-records] [--database-url]`**, the `record-currency-codes` shell one for one (occupancy gate, `--yes`, read-only dry-run boot, the "no app objects loaded" refusal, `refuseUndeclaredObjects`, journal-mode note, `--json` envelope). `--since` is judged before the probe, the prompt and the boot. The boot takes `buildDataMigrationPlugins({ settings: true, audit: true })`: a new `settings` arm adds the one-shot settings composition (`oneShotSettingsPlugin`, never mints a key), because without the settings service every organization reads as having no home currency. Exit 1 while any row is listed and skipped, on a dry run as on an apply. Rows added to the three CLI rosters that discover commands from the tree (`migrate-confirmation-exit.pin`, `schema-migrate.one-shot-family`, `json-stdout-purity`).

**Ledgers this diff had to teach:** `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` (#21918) gains the recompute's rows: it asks `isFederatedUnprovisionedInjectedColumn` and leaves a federated object's unprovisioned `organization_id` / `updated_at` out of its read and its write (disposition `skips`). `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains the CLI test double, whose `update` routes through `assertEngineUpdateDispatch` (coverage grows, regenerated with `--write`).

**Docs:** `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` gains "Recomputing stored home amounts"; `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` gains the table row and the `os migrate recompute-home-amounts` section beside `record-currency-codes`.

**ADR anchor:** `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__home-amount-recompute.ts.json` (ADR-0144: no second copy of the arithmetic; skip classes; Open item 8).

## ADR-0144 open items settled here

For the epic PM to carry into the ADR in its own PR:

- **Open item 8 (a row a backfill skips).** Proposal, pinned: (1) a skipped row is never written: its home amount and rate stay as stored, so a never-converted row stays blank, never 0 or a 1:1 conversion; (2) the run is not complete while any row is skipped: `homeAmountRecomputeComplete` is false and the command exits 1, on a dry run and on an apply, until a re-run skips nothing; (3) the applied run's `sys_audit_log` entry records the skipped rows (counts per organization and reason, and each row with its reason, currency and date), so the gap outlives the terminal. A per-row marker column was not chosen: it would be a new author-visible field or an injected column (D8 rule 2), i.e. spec work.
- **Parameter 1 as built:** report and skip a row with no rate in force on its document date, apply the rest; plus four sibling skip classes (above), each with its own remedy, a blank code apart from a missing rate (ruling 6492000994 item 5).
- **`--since` reading:** the document date (`rateDate`), as the write reads it.

## Declarations re-derived

The order proposed `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. Corrected to **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`**: new `@objectstack/objectql` exports (`recomputeHomeAmounts` and its report helpers and types, the `HomeAmountReads` / `HomeAmountServing` / `ExchangeRateRow` types), a new public engine method (`homeAmountReadsFor`), a new CLI command. Nothing narrows. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no authorable key, value or type changes. One changeset, `patch` for both packages. `packages/spec` is not touched.

## Verification

Head `90fabf3176` (the branch with `origin/main` `59e64635f4` merged in, no rebase).

- `packages/objectql` `src/engine-home-amount-projection.test.ts`: 42 / 42 (28 existing + 14 recompute pins, in-memory driver double over `applyDriverQueryInMemory`): a corrected rate (dry run lists 71994.24 @ 0.1389 → 80000 @ 0.125, writes nothing; apply moves only `amount_home` / `amount_rate`; a second run is clean); the recomputed row equals a fresh write; one audit entry per applied run, none for a dry run, `ledger_not_mounted` without the ledger; a missing rate listed with currency and date, skipped, the run incomplete, the audit entry naming it; a home field added over stored rows (rows without a rate stay blank, never 0); a blank code its own class with the `record-currency-codes` remedy; blank document date and unset home currency as their own classes; same currency at rate 1 with no rate read (1.005 → 1.01); a `datetime` document date across the Shanghai/UTC day boundary, for the rate and for `since`; `since` on the document date; two organizations, CNY and JPY homes, counted apart, a correction reaching only its own organization; four refusals before any read.
- `packages/qa/dogfood` `test/home-amount-projection.test.ts`: 42 / 42 = 3 cells (better-sqlite3, sqlite-wasm, PostgreSQL 16 via `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`) × (8 existing + 6 recompute pins): corrected rate with report-then-apply idempotence, the fresh-write equality and `updated_at` kept; a missing rate beside a filled row; a blank code; the same currency; the timezone boundary through a `datetime` column; two organizations under the `isolated` posture, each reading its own rate rows.
- `packages/cli`: `recompute-home-amounts.test.ts` 8 / 8; `test/migrate-confirmation-exit.pin.test.ts` 48 / 48; `schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts -t recompute-home-amounts` 5 / 5; `test/json-stdout-purity.e2e.test.ts` (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`) 95 / 95.
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/cli` pass (test-typecheck ledgers held; the cli one needs `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` on this container). eslint on every touched file: clean.
- Full `@objectstack/objectql` suite: 548 / 549 files, 10 862 / 10 863 tests on the head before `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` learned the recompute's two column reads; the recompute now asks `isFederatedUnprovisionedInjectedColumn` before selecting `organization_id` / `updated_at` and the table has its rows; that file and the recompute file re-run 47 / 47.

### Ablations

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored byte-identical (blob == HEAD).

| # | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | The report's value computed by a local float copy (`amount ÷ rate`, 2 decimals) instead of the projection's | 2 / 42 red (1.005 same-currency; the JPY organization) |
| A2 | The apply payload's home value replaced with `0` | 42 / 42 green: the stored value is the write's own projection, never the payload's |
| A3 | Apply context without `preserveAudit` (objectql rebuilt under it; dogfood) | 3 / 3 cells red on `updated_at` |
| A4 | The blank-code class removed | 1 red (the blank code is reported `unconvertible`) |
| A5 | `homeAmountRecomputeComplete` ignores skipped rows | 1 red |
| A6 | `since` exclusive (`<=`) | 1 red (the timezone-boundary pin) |
| A7 | Organization forced to none | 1 red (two organizations) |
| A8 | The SHARED projection's half-away step removed (`home-amount-projection.ts`) | the fixed-number pins red (2), while "a recomputed row equals a fresh write" stays green: write and recompute move together, one code path |

### Gates

`dispatch-gates --commands` on head `90fabf3176`: 105 derived commands, each exit code captured before any pipe, all 105 exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 105 derived / 105 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN (exit 0). Change set 19 paths, +1789 / −5, under the 3000-line human-merge threshold.
